verdicts.reason: A breaks the original's hierarchy. The SOLSTICE logo is pushed off to the left beside the can at an arbitrary height, and the SUNSET SALE ribbon floats loose in the upper middle. The CTA is squeezed into a 2x2 grid with the badges, so it looks like just another pill, and 'Small Batch' is no longer in line with the other two badges. The bottom is cramped while the top is empty, and the missing-asset box sits on top of the legal text. B keeps the original's centred stack and reading order (logo, can, headline, body, badges, CTA) with the ribbon in the corner, so it is faithful. But it is basically the portrait layout centred on a square canvas, with dead space on both sides and a narrow headline column. The legal line is tiny, and the missing-asset placeholder still covers its end.
